Interpret the sign/status matrix (SSM) of each ARINC 429 word below.

Word 1: 0xE0395BC1 (label 203)
Word 2: 0x612402D0 (label 013)

Answer with a single JSON object and nothing else: keys in alphabetical order, no spaces or line breaks, strings in double quotes. For each word N (1 and 2), report:
- "word_N_ssm": the SSM bits as a two-character string, bit 31 then bit 30 (for example "01")
- "word_N_meaning": what the SSM means for this word, given the label's data type in the label map. Use exactly one of these codes:
  "failure_warning", "no_computed_data", "functional_test", "normal_operation",
  "plus" (plus, north, east, right, to, above),
  "minus" (minus, south, west, left, from, below)

If a word fails the parity check, set its "word_N_meaning" to "reject" and leave out its "word_N_ssm".
